title: Canonical cycles transported through double truncation to the actual single-object unit
statement: Let C,D,S,n be as in [new-def-pc-derived-bottom-comparison], with n any integer, and let K be a cochain complex of C. Write P_n for the explicit initial portion of that bottom comparison: the inverse bounded-below/unbounded compatibility, inverse homology of the upper truncation inclusion, homology of the lower projection of that upper truncation, and homology of the canonical double-truncation-to-single isomorphism. Its codomain is H^n(R⁺S(single_n(H^n(truncGE_n(QK))))). The canonical lift of S of the cycle inclusion, followed by the homology quotient of S(K), inverse localization/homology comparison, H^n of the unbounded derived unit, H^n of RS of the lower-truncation projection, and P_n at QK equals S of the canonical quotient of K followed by inverse localization/homology comparison and H^n of that lower projection, followed by the actual single-object unit u_n of [new-lem-pc-derived-single-shift-normalization] at H^n(truncGE_n(QK)). This equation stops before the shifted single-object comparison and its degree-zero cancellation.

source.place: 05TC (2), double truncation; 05TD (3), the left-exact degree-zero unit comparison, with canonical-map elaboration from the parent node.

proof.text: Lift the lower truncation to M in D+(C), and form the fully faithful preimage f of the localized canonical cycle map followed by the lower projection. Its homology coefficient is exactly the cycle quotient followed by inverse localization/homology comparison and the homology of the lower projection.

Factor f through the specified bottom-homology inclusion. The actual derived-unit naturality equation identifies the original canonical-cycle prefix, including inverse compatibility, with the actual single unit on cycles followed by derived homology of f.

Naturality of the actual single-unit homology map follows by canceling the proved shifted single comparison and using its unit normalization. Move the coefficient across this unit. Expand the bottom-homology inclusion and cancel its upper inclusion, lower projection and inverse double identification against the explicit comparison. The upper derived homology map is invertible by the same distinguished-triangle negative-vanishing argument as in rightDerivedBottomToSingleIso. This yields the original equation with its signature unchanged.

proof_origin.place: 05TC (2), canonical double truncation; 05TD (3), actual derived unit. Canonical-map calculation written by R2 from the parent node and the named library comparisons.

theorem rightDerivedBottom_cycle_transport (n : ℤ) (K : CochainComplex C ℤ) :
    ((((S.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj K).sc n).liftCycles
        (S.map (K.sc n).iCycles) (by
          change S.map (K.sc n).iCycles ≫ S.map (K.sc n).g = 0
          rw [← S.map_comp, (K.sc n).iCycles_g, S.map_zero])) ≫
      (((S.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj K).sc n).homologyπ ≫
          ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctorFactors D n).app
            ((S.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj K)).inv ≫
          (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor D n).map
            (S.rightDerivedFunctorUnit.app ((HomotopyCategory.quotient C (.up ℤ)).obj K)) ≫
          (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor D n).map
            (S.rightDerivedFunctor.map
              ((DerivedCategory.TStructure.t.truncGEπ n).app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj K))) ≫
          (S.rightDerivedBottomToSingleIso n).hom.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj K) =
      S.map ((K.sc n).homologyπ ≫
        ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctorFactors C n).app K).inv ≫
        (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor C n).map
          ((DerivedCategory.TStructure.t.truncGEπ n).app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj K))) ≫
      S.rightDerivedPlusSingleUnitHomologyAt n
        ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor C n).obj
          ((DerivedCategory.TStructure.t.truncGE n).obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj K)))
